name: rx-tab-bar
title: Tab Bar (React)
description: Bottom tab bar for phone screens - TabBar, TabBarItem. Three looks on one API: material (full-width bar with a pill indicator), ios (floating translucent capsule) and floating (compact icon-only pill). Badges, hide on scroll, safe-area aware, asChild for router links.

usage.whenToUse: TBD - document when to use rx-tab-bar.
usage.whenNotToUse: TBD - document when to reach for something else.
